about.label: ABOUT
intro: Full Stack Developer with 8 years of professional experience. Native Spanish speaker with a C1 level of English.

I work as part of a 15-person development team and occasionally step in as coordinator when the main lead is unavailable. I serve as the architect and maintainer of ElasticSearch clusters and its Kibana interface. I also participate in the design and development of new features across our platform.
Currently seeking new opportunities in international teams, with a strong interest in expanding my skills in cybersecurity and AI/ML.

timeline.description: Lynx is a new company that emerged from ADIC – IIC. At this company, critical software is developed for banks, operating in Near Real Time with a response time of less than 100ms. It also includes a web application used for product management and data visualization, along with storage in both relational and non-relational databases. Among my main responsibilities:
achievements: Responsible for architecture and sizing of Elasticsearch (and Opensearch) clusters for our customers and managing their Kibana (and Opensearch Dashboards) web interfaces.
Backend developer of the described product, taking on the role of coordinator in the absence of the main coordinator.
Main product lead for one of the clients, handling email management, applying fixes, new features, and maintenance in a Linux (RedHat) environment.
Part of the team responsible for migrating the product to the cloud (AWS)
DevOps application – CI/CD for the software, performing unit tests and continuous integration.

timeline.description: I worked as a developer in a team that maintained and enhanced a critical product for banks (Lynx, as explained earlier). My main responsibilities included:
achievements: Developing backend improvements and new features for the product in a Linux (Red Hat) environment.
Maintaining Elasticsearch clusters for both the company and its clients.
Acting as part of the team responsible for a major client, managing email communication and participating in meetings about potential requirements and issues.
